headline: Make LIFX lighting part of the moment
intro: Control LIFX lights directly over your local network with Home Assistant. Set color and brightness, paint themes across multizone and matrix lights, and use model-specific effects in automations without sending commands through the LIFX cloud.
highlights: Control power, brightness, color, and color temperature where the model supports them
Run effects such as Pulse, Morph, Flame, and Sky on compatible lights
Paint themes across multizone and matrix lights, or schedule HEV cycles on LIFX Clean

flow.title: Bring a LIFX light into Home Assistant
